title: Normalization of support scalar mate as a projection arrow
statement: For a finite ring homomorphism A → B, compactification c, supplied scalar extension adjunctions, and intrinsic source complex K, the scalar-restricted support mate is isomorphic in the arrow category to the proper projection map at the constant target module underlying B.

proof.text: Compare scalar extension with tensoring by the constant B-module on K-flat models, normalize inverse-image tensor comparison, and transpose the proper and open mates. The two counit transposes agree, yielding the displayed arrow isomorphism.

proof_origin: Stated as the independent arrow-level normalization calculation.
